user.title: Authentication
user.description: Choose api_key or local. Browser cookies are never used.

connection.title: Connect to UniFi
connection.description: Enter fresh local credentials. Readable WAN counters are required. For self-signed certificates, explicitly disable TLS verification.

interface.title: Select WAN interface
interface.description: Add one entry per WAN to monitor multiple interfaces.

quota.title: Billing cycle allowance
quota.description: 100 GB means 100 billion bytes, RX + TX. Known initial usage is used only at the first sample. Changing billing day clears the local cycle usage.

error.invalid_host: Enter an HTTPS console address without credentials or a path.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication rejected. Use a new local API key or a dedicated local account.
error.key_no_counters: The key works for official sites, but cannot read internal port counters. Try local account authentication.
error.unsupported_endpoint: This endpoint is unavailable on the console. Check Network version and site.
error.invalid_data: No unambiguous WAN port counters found. Check the site, selected gateway and port mapping.
error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check address, permissions, TLS certificate and Network availability.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Gateway and interface must match the existing entry.

init.title: Billing cycle allowance
init.description: 100 GB means 100 billion bytes, RX + TX. Known initial usage is used only at the first sample. Changing billing day clears the local cycle usage.
